nodes.label: Convex Transaction Limits
nodes.rationale: Query/mutation exec time 1s, action 10min, data read/write 16MiB, docs scanned 32000, index ranges 4096, docs written 16000, doc size 1MiB, return value 16MiB

nodes.label: Unbounded .collect() Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Calling .collect() without a limit grows unboundedly with table size and can exceed transaction read limits

nodes.label: Cursor-Based Batch Processing Pattern
nodes.rationale: Self-scheduling internalMutation with cursor enables safe large-scale mutations without exceeding transaction limits

nodes.label: Actions for Heavy Work Pattern
nodes.rationale: CPU-intensive computation, external API calls, or file processing should use actions (outside transactions) instead of mutations

nodes.label: Push Filters to Storage (withIndex)
nodes.rationale: Only withIndex() and withSearchIndex() reduce docs scanned. JS .filter() and Convex .filter() both scan first. Prefer index-based filtering to minimize reads.

nodes.label: Digest / Summary Tables Pattern
nodes.rationale: Hot list pages should read the smallest document shape. A summary/digest table with subset fields is cheaper than full source docs on hot paths.

nodes.label: Isolate Frequently-Updated Fields
nodes.rationale: High-churn fields (lastSeen, counters, presence) should be in separate documents to avoid invalidating all subscribers of widely-read documents

nodes.label: Denormalization for Hot Paths
nodes.rationale: Denormalize when path is hot, joined doc is much larger than needed field, and many readers pay join cost repeatedly. Always fall back to live read if denormalized field is missing.

nodes.label: Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC)
nodes.rationale: Convex uses OCC: when two transactions overlap, one retries. High contention causes wasted work and latency spikes. Counter sharding and deferring secondary writes reduces conflicts.

nodes.label: Hot Document Splitting Pattern
nodes.rationale: Shard counters across multiple documents to reduce write contention. Aggregate shards in query or scheduled job.

nodes.label: Schedule Secondary Work Pattern
nodes.rationale: Move analytics, non-critical notifications, and cache warming out of the primary mutation using ctx.scheduler.runAfter to reduce transaction read/write set size

nodes.label: Reactive Subscriptions (useQuery)
nodes.rationale: Every useQuery/usePaginatedQuery creates a live subscription. Server re-executes query when read set changes. Cost = subscriptions x invalidation_frequency x query_cost.

nodes.label: Point-in-Time Reads Pattern
nodes.rationale: For high-read/low-freshness flows use fetchQuery, ConvexHttpClient.query(), or server-rendered fetches instead of reactive subscriptions to avoid ongoing subscription cost

nodes.label: @convex-dev/aggregate Component
nodes.rationale: Maintains denormalized COUNT, SUM, MAX values efficiently for leaderboards, totals, badges without reactive full-table scans

nodes.label: Date.now() in Queries Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Using Date.now() inside a query defeats Convex query caching, causing frequent re-evaluation. Use boolean flags updated by scheduled functions instead.

nodes.label: CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous
nodes.rationale: Forces unauthenticated local backend. Binds to 127.0.0.1. No browser login or team prompts. Used for AI coding agents and CI-like setup scripts.

nodes.label: react-vite-shadcn Template
nodes.rationale: Default template for simple apps: React + Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui

nodes.label: nextjs-shadcn Template
nodes.rationale: Default template for apps needing SSR or API routes: Next.js App Router + Tailwind + shadcn/ui

nodes.label: ConvexReactClient / ConvexProvider
nodes.rationale: Must be created at module scope (not inside component) and wrap the app at the root. Framework-specific env var: VITE_CONVEX_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL, CONVEX_URL, EXPO_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL.

nodes.label: convex/auth.config.ts
nodes.rationale: Required JWT auth config file for all auth providers. Without it, ctx.auth.getUserIdentity() always returns null. Defines providers array with domain (issuer URL) and applicationID.

nodes.label: ctx.auth.getUserIdentity()
nodes.rationale: Server-side identity retrieval. Returns null if unauthenticated. Use tokenIdentifier (not subject) as canonical stable identifier for auth-linked DB lookups.

nodes.label: tokenIdentifier Canonical Identity Key
nodes.rationale: tokenIdentifier is guaranteed and canonical stable identifier for authenticated identity. Prefer over identity.subject for auth-linked DB lookups and ownership checks.

nodes.label: ConvexProviderWithAuth
nodes.rationale: Use ConvexProviderWithAuth instead of ConvexProvider when using external auth providers. Must provide useAuth prop returning {isLoading, isAuthenticated, fetchAccessToken}.

nodes.label: Clerk Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN / CLERK_FRONTEND_API_URL (same value), VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, CLERK_SECRET_KEY

nodes.label: Auth0 Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, VITE_AUTH0_DOMAIN, VITE_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID. Auth0 CLI path for automated setup via auth0 apps create.

nodes.label: WorkOS Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: WORKOS_CLIENT_ID, WORKOS_API_KEY, WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD, VITE_WORKOS_CLIENT_ID, VITE_WORKOS_REDIRECT_URI, NEXT_PUBLIC_WORKOS_REDIRECT_URI. convex.json required with authKit section.

nodes.label: Convex Auth Packages
nodes.rationale: @convex-dev/auth and @auth/core@0.37.0 required. Run npx @convex-dev/auth to initialize. Creates auth.config.ts, auth.ts, http.ts. Add authTables to schema.ts.

nodes.label: HTTP Endpoints (httpAction)
nodes.rationale: HTTP endpoints defined in convex/http.ts using httpAction decorator and httpRouter. Registered at exact path specified.

nodes.label: Convex Validators (v.*)
nodes.rationale: ALWAYS include argument validators for all Convex functions. Validators: v.id, v.null, v.int64, v.number, v.boolean, v.string, v.bytes, v.array, v.object, v.record, v.union, v.literal, v.optional.

nodes.label: Function Registration (public vs internal)
nodes.rationale: Use internalQuery/internalMutation/internalAction for private functions. Use query/mutation/action for public API. Do NOT use query/mutation for sensitive internal functions.

nodes.label: Pagination (paginationOptsValidator)
nodes.rationale: Use paginationOptsValidator for paginated queries. Returns {page, isDone, continueCursor}. Never use .collect().length to count rows.

nodes.label: Schema Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Define schema in convex/schema.ts. No unbounded arrays in documents. Separate high-churn data (heartbeats, presence) from stable profile data. Always include all index fields in index name.

nodes.label: No .filter() - Use withIndex()
nodes.rationale: Do NOT use filter in queries. Define an index and use withIndex instead. Always return bounded collections (.take() or paginate), never unbounded .collect().

nodes.label: Actions and Node.js Runtime
nodes.rationale: Add 'use node' for actions using Node.js built-ins. Never mix with queries/mutations in same file. Never use ctx.db inside actions.

nodes.label: Cron Jobs (cronJobs)
nodes.rationale: Use crons.interval or crons.cron only. NOT crons.hourly/daily/weekly. Takes FunctionReference, not function directly.

nodes.label: Testing with convex-test
nodes.rationale: Use convex-test with vitest and @edge-runtime/vm. Configure vitest with environment: 'edge-runtime'. Pass import.meta.glob module map to convexTest.
